sycamore-grove-mennonite-garden-city-mo.assessment: Sycamore Grove Mennonite Church is a CMC/Rosedale Network congregation in rural Cass County, Missouri, southeast of Kansas City. Pastor Mike Baker took the senior pastor position in 2016. The church describes itself as "a small country church committed to standing firm on the Word of God" and maintains active MYF (Mennonite Youth Fellowship) groups for both junior high and senior high students. The CMC/Rosedale Network requires pastors to understand the CMC Statement of Theology and be affirmed by CMC conference leaders — meaningful denominational accountability. Green rating.
